class_id: a printed table row whose label wraps lines is read as absent
feature: any document table reader that recognises a row by its label at the start of ONE line (today: the Schedule III ratio-note reader scraper/scripts/financial_ratios.py, current_ratio and inventory_turnover), and any reader that sends a reader miss out in the same shape as a stated absence or a refusal
symptom: pdfplumber lays a multi-line table cell out line by line, so a row label that wraps in its cell ('Inventory Turnover' / 'Ratio') lands on the lines ABOVE and BELOW the line that carries the serial and the values. A matcher that needs the whole label on the values line finds no row and reports the field absent (ratio_row_not_in_note) although the document prints it. The miss then left the extractor as a PASSING null (emit.null), the same shape as a stated absence, so a consumer could not tell 'the reader missed it' from 'the document does not print it' or 'a value was read and refused'.
first_seen: 2026-10-01 (F-219) -- committed real fixtures: German Green Steel RHP page 440 (scraper/tests/fixtures/financial-ratios/german-green-steel-ratio-analysis.txt) prints 'Inventory Turnover account of stagnant revenue' / '5 Total Revenue from Customers Traded Inventories 5.63 6.02 8.85 -6.41% (31.97)%' / 'Ratio and increase holding level of'; read_ratio(...,'inventory_turnover',(2026,3,31)) returned {value: null, reason: 'ratio_row_not_in_note'}. The before/after run over all 7 committed ratio fixtures found a second real member: Water Infra page 427 ('Inventory Turnover' / 'over Average 3.00 3.57 4.67 (16.02%) (23.51%) - -' / 'Ratio'), also ratio_row_not_in_note before, 3.00 for FY25 after. 258 of the 294 fixture x key x period x basis reads were unchanged; the 36 that changed are all these two rows (inventory_turnover on German Green and Water Infra).
fix_prs: #1420 step 1 (fix/1420-extractor-answer-states): financial_ratios.wrapped_row joins a wrapped label bounded to head line / one values line / tail line, refusing a middle line that carries another ratio's label; every extractor field record now carries `state` (VALUE, REFUSED with refused_value, STATED_NOT_PRINTED from the shared allow-list scraper/src/config/stated-absence-reasons.json, MISSED, LOW_CONFIDENCE_OCR)
detection_check: scraper/scripts/test_financial_ratios.py test_a_wrapped_inventory_turnover_label_is_read (both real fixtures) and test_a_wrapped_label_is_not_stitched_across_another_ratios_row; scraper/scripts/test_extract_filing_answer_states.py (every field of a real document carries a known state; every check function given no inputs answers MISSED). No runtime or nightly check measures how many PRINTED ratio rows the reader misses on live documents: issuer_ratio_yield (scripts/lib/ratio-yield-verdict.mjs) judges current_ratio only, not inventory_turnover
status: unguarded in production for inventory_turnover: the fixture tests guard the two measured layouts; a third wrapping shape (label split over more than three lines, or values two lines away) is not covered and no live check counts misses
